summary: Iteration 7 review — new GET /api/gratitude-wall endpoint, /gratitude-wall screen with two entry points, and page-1 (morningRitual/'Taking Control') affirmation-banner exclusion. Backend: 71/71 pytest pass (62 regression + 9 new iter7). /api/gratitude-wall verified: seeded blessings on 3 dates (09-04/05/06, 2 per day) → response is exactly {items:[{date,text}], total:6} sorted newest-first (Sun→Fri), empty strings filtered, item keys strictly {date,text}. Empty user returns {items:[], total:0}. Missing userId returns 400. Ignores entries whose blessings are all empty. Regressions green: /api/gratitude-trends still ranks 'family time' with count=2; /api/day GET+PUT persist; /api/calendar includes restDayAvailable/currentStreak; /api/search page-10 (journal) match; auth register→login→me flow. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) seeded uid TEST_i7_ui_0fc947c3 via 3 PUT /api/day calls and localStorage.setItem('aura.userId', JSON.stringify(uid)) — the storage helper uses JSON.parse so plain-string writes throw (already handled by app on first run, but tests must stringify). With seed active: (a) Progress screen 'Gratitude Wall' row shows testID gratitude-wall-btn → tapping navigates to /gratitude-wall which renders header '6 moments of gratitude' and 6 items in strict newest-first order (2×Sep 6, 2×Sep 5, 2×Sep 4). (b) Tapping wall-item-0 pushes /day/2026-09-06 which renders that day's BLESSINGS card ('gratitude on 2026-09-06', 'warm coffee'). (c) Today's 'A recurring gratitude' card (testID gratitude-reminder) is visible and tapping it navigates to /gratitude-wall. Daily flow banner exclusion verified with a fresh anonymous userId (Day 1 = special): step order is mood → affirmations → morningRitual → weeklyGoals → …; on step 3 'Taking Control' (Page 1, morningRitual) after picking affirmation-0 on step 2, [data-testid=affirmation-banner] is NOT rendered; on step 4 'Weekly Goals' the banner IS rendered with the selected text 'I move through today with steady clarity.'. No deprecated Expo packages, no red screens, no console errors (only benign expo-notifications web warnings and one storage parse warning triggered by our raw-string seed which is not user-reachable).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:887-899 /api/gratitude-wall — collects blessings across ALL entries, trims empties, sorts by date desc, returns {items,total}. Item shape is strictly {date,text}. Matches spec exactly.
server.py:891 uses find(...).to_list(3000) — same cap as gratitude-trends; adequate for a personal journal but a future .sort()+limit approach would be nicer if users ever exceed ~3k entries.

flow.tsx:488 affirmation-banner render condition now excludes 'morningRitual' in addition to 'affirmations' and 'final' — Taking Control step correctly hides the banner. Verified live: step 3 no banner, step 4 has banner.

flow.tsx:92-100 step order for special days: mood → affirmations → morningRitual → weeklyGoals → blessings → workout → dailyGoals → quote → actionsYesterday → actionsTomorrow → journal → weekly → final. Consistent with the exclusion (banner starts appearing from weeklyGoals onward).

gratitude-wall.tsx — clean FlatList with testID wall-back, wall-item-{i}; EmptyState handled; router.push(`/day/${item.date}`) navigates into day-detail. useSafeAreaInsets applied. Uses fonts/theme from shared modules — no HTML elements.

(tabs)/profile.tsx:80-81 gratitude-wall-btn Pressable pushes /gratitude-wall. (tabs)/index.tsx:129-130 gratitude-reminder Pressable pushes /gratitude-wall. Both entry points reachable and gated only by content availability (reminder only shown when a blessing repeats >=2).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests use per-test anonymous userIds prefixed TEST_i7_ and seed data via PUT /api/day. Frontend: seeded uid TEST_i7_ui_0fc947c3 with 3 entries (2026-09-04/05/06, 2 blessings each: 'gratitude on {date}' + 'warm coffee'); flow test used a fresh TEST_i7_flow_* userId (Day 1 = special). All data isolated by userId prefix — no production data touched. Note for future agents: aura.userId in localStorage must be JSON.stringify()-wrapped because the storage helper uses JSON.parse; a raw string emits a benign parse warning and falls back to an anonymous uid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter7 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_features.py. /api/gratitude-wall?userId=... returns {items:[{date,text}], total}; sort is by date DESC (string sort works for YYYY-MM-DD). Frontend seed pattern: PUT /api/day/{d}?userId=SEED for each date, then in browser localStorage.setItem('aura.userId', JSON.stringify('SEED')) + reload. Flow banner exclusion list is at flow.tsx:488 — {affirmations, final, morningRitual}. Server today=2026-09-06; first-visit anonymous userId → Day 1 → is_special=true so morningRitual step is present.
